prompt_text: Where should I stay in Branson Missouri, an Airbnb or a hotel, and which specific places are best?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: it depends on your group and priorities.

Quick guidance
- Choose a hotel if you want convenience to shows/Strip restaurants, on-site amenities (pool, breakfast, front‑desk help), easier parking, and predictable service. Good for couples, older travelers, or anyone who wants low fuss.
- Choose an Airbnb/vacation rental (cabins, condos, lake houses) if you want more space, a kitchen, better value for larger groups, or a lakefront/private feel—great for families, groups, or anyone wanting to be on Table Rock Lake or in a quieter neighborhood.

Where to stay by priority
- Best for show/go‑out convenience: stay on or near the 76 Country Boulevard (“Branson Strip”) or Branson Landing—short drive or walk to most theaters, restaurants, and attractions.
- Best for lake/outdoor focus: look for cabins/condos on Table Rock Lake (Indian Point, Kimberling City, Shepherd of the Hills area) or Big Cedar Lodge area.
- Best for families/groups who want resort amenities: resort hotels or large vacation homes with kitchens and multiple bedrooms.
- Best value: vacation rentals outside the Strip (Branson West, Hollister, Kimberling City) or midrange hotels with free breakfast (Drury, Holiday Inn Express, Hampton Inn).

Specific options (well‑reviewed and commonly recommended)
Hotels / Resorts
- Chateau on the Lake Resort Spa & Convention Center — luxury lakefront property with spa and nice views; good for couples and upscale stays.
- Big Cedar Lodge — high‑end lodge/resort south of Branson with extensive outdoor/amenity options; pricier but terrific for an “Ozarks resort” experience.
- Drury Plaza Hotel Branson — reliable midrange option with free breakfast/evening snacks and good location for shows.
- Hilton Branson Convention Center / Welk Resort Branson — convenient, family-friendly, good on‑site activities and pools.
- Keeter Center at College of the Ozarks — unique boutique‑style inn (small, quieter, higher quality) if you want something different.

Airbnbs / Vacation rentals
- Lakefront cabins on Table Rock Lake (Indian Point, Kimberling City, Shepherd of the Hills): great for boating, fishing, sunset views, big decks and privacy.
- Cabins near Silver Dollar City / west 76 area: easy access to the theme park and Shepherd of the Hills attractions.
- Condos at Branson Landing or near the Strip: walkable to dining/shopping and good for small families or couples.

Practical tips
- Book early for summer, school breaks and fall “leaf” season—Branson fills quickly.
- If you’re attending nightly shows, being on/near the Strip saves driving and parking time.
- If you’ll be boating or want lake time, prioritize a lakefront rental or a hotel with boat access.
- Rent a car unless you plan to stay strictly on the Strip/Branson Landing—many attractions are spread out.
- Read recent reviews for cleanliness, noise, and host responsiveness (Airbnbs) and check cancellation policies.

If you tell me: travel dates, how many people, budget, and whether you prefer lake vs shows vs central convenience, I’ll give 3–5 specific hotel and Airbnb listings currently suited to your trip.
